points.description: Lists at least two correct irrigation methods from: sprinkler, drip, furrow, flood (equivalent names such as surface/basin/border accepted if correct).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one correct method is listed.

points.description: Lists all four methods: sprinkler irrigation, drip irrigation, furrow method, and flood method (equivalent wording accepted).
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if three of the four are listed.
